answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a trellis of randomized capability proofs: every epoch, each agent must pass a fresh, unique benchmark task - a small reasoning or tool-use puzzle drawn at random - inside a short time window. The tasks are generated per identity, so answers cannot be copied between puppets, and each pearl of a solution proves live compute behind that name. Like tending a garden, the check repeats every epoch, so an attacker running a thousand fakes must pay a thousand benchmarks' worth of compute each round, while one honest agent passes one test and keeps working.
